objective.name: correlation
objective.description: Defines the correlation data carried by a message to express causal, intentional, wait-group, or continuity relationships.

functional._causation_id_note: Optional. Identifies the message or event that directly caused the current message.
functional._intention_id_note: Optional. Identifies the Brique intention to which the current message is related.
functional._wait_group_id_note: Optional. Identifies the wait group to which the current message contributes.
functional._continuity_id_note: Optional. Identifies a related continuity, for example the source or delegated child continuity associated with the message.
